include_directories(..)

if(NOT MSVC)
    set_source_files_properties(main.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wno-write-strings")
endif()

# cmicontrol.exe is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cmicontrol-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(cmicontrol_shims OBJECT main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cmicontrol_shims PRIVATE libuser32 libgdi32 libole32 libadvapi32 libcomctl32 libshell32 libdsound libsetupapi libwinmm libmsvcrt libkernel32)
add_dependencies(cmicontrol_shims psdk)
add_cargo_module(cmicontrol cmicontrol-cargo cmicontrol.exe
    KIND win32exe
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    EXTRA_DEPENDS cmicontrol_shims psdk)
